name: WonderEvents
short: Movie and game nights: RSVP buttons, Discord scheduled events, votes, reminders and attendance.
description: Staff run `.night create movie` and fill in a short form. The bot posts the event with the kind's ping role, Going / Maybe / Can't make it buttons and a time everyone sees in their own timezone, creates a native Discord Scheduled Event in the voice channel, posts a native vote for the movie/game, reminds only the people who said Going/Maybe an hour before, marks the event live at start and samples the voice channel to record who actually came (`.night regulars`).
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores, per event, the user IDs of members who RSVP'd and how many minutes each member spent in the event's voice channel, plus a staff member's chosen timezone if they set one. It is deleted on a Red data-deletion request.
install_msg: Set up with `.night channel #server-updates`, then `.night kind add movie @MovieNightRole #Movie Night VC 🎬 3` and `.night kind add game @GameNightRole #Game VC 🎮 3`. Create events with `.night create movie`. The bot needs Manage Events for the Discord scheduled event.
author: evacfk
